theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have H : ∀ {a b c d : List Expression.Ident},
      a ⊆ c ++ [h1] → b ⊆ d ++ [h1] → a ++ b ⊆ c ++ d ++ [h1] := by
    intro a b c d ha hb x hx
    simp only [List.subset_def, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at ha hb hx ⊢
    cases hx with
    | inl h => cases ha h with
      | inl hc => exact .inl (.inl hc)
      | inr hk => exact .inr hk
    | inr h => cases hb h with
      | inl hd => exact .inl (.inr hd)
      | inr hk => exact .inr hk
  induction post <;>
    simp only [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case const => exact List.nil_subset _
  case op => exact List.nil_subset _
  case bvar => exact List.nil_subset _
  case fvar => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case quant ti ei => exact H ti ei
  case ite ci ti ei => exact H (H ci ti) ei
  case eq i1 i2 => exact H i1 i2
  case app fi ei =>
    split
    · split
      · exact List.subset_cons_self _ _
      · exact List.subset_append_left _ _
    · exact H fi ei
